provenance: Larry's son's written report, sent to the archive on the evening of 2026-09-05, of what Larry said at the table while drawing the base camp sheet (VD-0001) that afternoon. His son listened and did not take notes, so this is his summary from memory in his own words, not Larry's words. Larry offered to draw the three sheets himself; his son had not raised it.
text: The base drawing with the shower he was describing where the shooting took place of the guy who came in and shot his buddy in the shower and then aimed the gun at my father and then Weaver came in from the right side.
researchNotes: The shooting is the incident of the 2026-08-15 account (giscus-stories-c18035411, ledger #11, timeline 1965-02-bathroom-shooting): a drunk soldier from another unit shot a man in the chest in the shower beside Larry's hooch, turned the pistol on Larry, and Sgt. Weaver arrived while it was still out. New in this report: the shooter 'came in', and Weaver came in 'from the right side'. Whether 'right' is the right of the sheet, the right of the shower as Larry stood in it, or something else was not asked. What he said about the two figures drawn in the SHOWER box on VD-0001, and about the curved line beside it, is not on record; the drawing's description leaves them uninterpreted.
